items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-27
items.q: Charlie Johnson was the piano player... And that was the band, Charlie Johnson's band... I used to go down there because I enjoyed the sound of the band

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. You reminded me of something when you mentioned Jabba. Did they have a band at Smalls Paradise, or just a piano player, or what?
Well, Charlie Johnson was the piano player.
